final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Let the composition feel like thought gathering, colliding, and loosening: dense overlapping sweeps of deep ultramarine, charcoal, and bruised violet press against flashes of warm ochre, coral, and pale mineral blue. Use varied brushwork—broad dragged strokes, dry scumbles, fine scratches, soft washes, and small bursts of thick pigment—with visible texture and many translucent layers. Build a restless rhythm of compression and release, with energetic diagonal gestures clustering off-center and dissolving into generous, quiet areas of muted color. Make contrast and spatial tension carry the image; allow edges to blur, scrape, interrupt, and reappear. Keep the whole canvas abstract, with no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Fill the entire square image with paint, with no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
